tools.name: translate_morse
tools.description: Translates text to Morse code or Morse code to text. Returns the result, a letter-by-letter breakdown with the dot and dash patterns, the signal timing at the chosen speed and a link to the SandiMorse translator with the same input. The widget plays the sound and blinks a lamp.

tools.name: morse_chart
tools.description: Returns the Morse code chart for letters A to Z, digits 0 to 9 and punctuation, or the code of one character with its dot and dash counts and memory tips. Includes a link to the matching SandiMorse page.

tools.name: encode_scout_code
tools.description: Writes a message in one of the scout codes on SandiMorse: kotak 1, 2 and 3, rumput, semaphore, angka, koordinat, Merah Putih, Polybius, AZ (Atbash), AN (ROT13), kimia, jam, AND, Napoleon or ular. Returns the coded text, or a picture for the drawn codes, with the key used and a link to the SandiMorse

tools.name: decode_scout_code
tools.description: Reads a coded message back to text in angka, koordinat, Merah Putih, Polybius, AZ (Atbash), AN (ROT13), kimia, jam, AND, Napoleon or ular. Kotak, rumput and semaphore are drawings and have no text reader. Returns the decoded text, the key used and a link to the SandiMorse page with the same input.

tools.name: morse_practice
tools.description: Returns ten Morse code practice questions with their answers: letter to code, code to letter, words, listening and mixed rounds. Listening questions carry the code to play. Includes a link to the SandiMorse practice page.

tools.name: list_codes
tools.description: Lists the Morse and scout codes on SandiMorse with the name, what each one is, its key, whether it can encode and decode, an example message and a link to its page.
